text: Meta spent billions building the metaverse. For years, the avatars had no legs. A VR headset has cameras that point outward. It can see your hands. It can't see your legs. So the computer has to guess where your knees are from your head and hands. Guess wrong and the legs bend backwards. That's why most VR avatars just float. In 2022, Mark Zuckerberg announced legs were coming. Meta later admitted the leg demo wasn't live tracking. The metaverse: billions of dollars, zero knees.
